from flask import Flask, request, g
import sqlite3
app = Flask(__name__)

DATABASE = 'quotes.db'

def get_db():
    db = getattr(g, '_database', None)
    if db is None:
        db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
    return db

@app.route('/update_quote', methods=['POST'])
def update_quote():
    user = request.form['user']
    quote = request.form['quote']

    query = "UPDATE quotes SET quote = ? WHERE user = ?"

    db = get_db()
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(query, (quote, user))
    db.commit()

    return 'Quote updated!'
